Functional Details
Hidden side pockets provide convenient storage for phones, lipsticks, and small essentials. Adjustable shoulder straps allow for a customized fit, accommodating different shoulder shapes for greater comfort.

Versatile Styling Options
Wear it solo as a standout summer dress or layer over cardigans or denim jackets. Paired with straw hats and woven bags, it easily transitions between bohemian, casual, and vintage styles.

products.title: Bohemian-style Neck-wrap Vacation Dress
products.body_html:
Relaxed Silhouette
A loose A-line shape combined with a waist-draped pleat design flatters all body types, effectively concealing curves and creating a slimming effect. Its flowing drape adds an effortlessly elegant touch, making it perfect for various casual settings such as vacations, beaches, and markets.

Contrasting Detail Design
A deep V-neckline paired with vibrant orange trims along the sides and hem brightens the overall look against a neutral gray base. This retro-chic combination creates eye-catching style while subtly elongating the neck line.

Breathable, Skin-Friendly Fabric
Made from lightweight, slightly crinkled sheer fabric that offers excellent breathability and prevents sweat buildup. With a soft drape and subtle texture, it feels cool and comfortable in summer, evoking a laid-back vacation vibe.

Functional Details
Hidden side pockets provide convenient storage for phones, lipsticks, and small essentials. Adjustable shoulder straps allow for a customized fit, accommodating different shoulder shapes for greater comfort.

Versatile Styling Options
Wear it solo as a standout summer dress or layer over cardigans or denim jackets. Paired with straw hats and woven bags, it easily transitions between bohemian, casual, and vintage styles.

Overview

The Nocturne Lace Gown is a masterpiece of dark romanticism and modern allure. Crafted from intricate floral guipure lace, this floor-sweeping silhouette features daring waist cut-outs and a dramatic thigh-high slit, balancing modest high-neck tailoring with contemporary edge. Design Features

  • Neckline: Elegant high-standing mandarin collar for a refined, regal look.

  • Sleeves: Delicate cap sleeves that provide minimal coverage while maintaining a structured shoulder line.

Specifications

  • Material: Premium Corded Floral Lace (100% Nylon/Polyester blend).

Size & Fit

Care Instructions

  • Professional dry clean only.

  • Keep away from sharp jewelry to prevent snagging.

H-shaped straight tube medium length loose skirt body

Flat ribbed hem
The hem has a narrow ribbed closure to prevent the knitted fabric from curling and elongating, resulting in a neat and streamlined design without dragging.

  2. Voluminous Balloon Puff Long Sleeves Oversized loose balloon long sleeves with elasticated ruffled cuffs at the wrist; abundant fabric volume delivers dramatic billowy movement, lightweight satin holds the rounded puff shape without sagging.
  3. Cropped Waist Hem Silhouette Short cropped length ending right above the natural waist, straight clean bottom hem to expose midriff, relaxed loose fit through torso that balances the oversized sleeves for a flattering airy shape.

Lightweight high-luster stretch satin fabric with vivid luminous glossy finish, smooth silky handfeel, fully lined to eliminate transparency, wrinkle-resistant, fluid drape that highlights the puff sleeve volume.

Style Positioning Evening party cropped top / Wedding guest dressy blouse / Romantic date night satin top / Upscale cocktail going-out blouse

Fit & Fabric

Care Tip

products.body_html:
Innenraumluftfilter für BMW E82 E88 E90 E91 E92 E93 X1 E84 335i 135i 328i 325i 


E-Serien-Besitzer wissen, dass das Entfernen der Motorhaube und des HVAC-Filtersystems nicht nur das Gewicht des Fahrzeugs reduziert, sondern auch die Kühlung des gesamten Motorraums verbessert, die Wartung des Motors und der DME-Box erleichtert und es dem Fahrer ermöglicht, den laufenden Motor besser zu hören. 

Aber es stellt sich immer die Frage, wie man verhindert, dass Staub und Schmutz in das interne Belüftungssystem gelangen. 

Aus diesem Grund haben wir eine einfache Version des Klimaanlagenfilters eingeführt, die speziell für diese Aufgabe entwickelt wurde.


Merkmale:

【Reduziertes Fahrzeuggewicht】Reduziert das Gewicht um ca. 10 lbs, ohne Haube und HVAC-Filtersystem.

【Bessere Kühlung des Motorraums】Der Motor klingt ohne Motorhaube besser und ermöglicht eine bessere Kühlung.

【Klimaanlagenfilter】Hält Schmutz und Ablagerungen aus dem inneren Belüftungssystem fern.

【Einfache Kontrolle und Wartung】Einfacher Zugang zu DME-Boxen oder Wartung von Zündkerzen, Ventildeckeln, etc.

【Einfache Installation und Reinigung】Zur Reinigung mit Wasser abspülen, trocknen lassen und wieder einbauen. Nicht einölen.

products.title: Digital Torque Wrench SN-2340CN
products.body_html:
1、 Product positioning and core values
SN-2340CN is a high-precision digital torque control tool designed for scenarios that require strict control of bolt/nut tightening torque (such as automotive, mechanical, aviation, etc.). Through real-time digital display, intelligent alarm, data tracing and other functions, it solves the pain points of traditional wrenches such as "torque ambiguity and large errors", ensuring assembly quality and safety.
2、 Basic parameters
Project Details
Model SN-2340CN
Weight 2.628kg (balancing durability and portability)
Dimensions: 74 × 14 × 7.5cm (total length suitable for regular operations, compact structure)
3、 Structural analysis (combined with graphic design)

Schematic diagram of digital torque wrench structure
image

Head system:
Double sided ratchet head+ratchet torque square head: compatible with dual specifications, covering more types of bolts, easy to switch.
Central functional area:
Direction paddles: One click switch for forward/reverse, suitable for different fastening direction requirements.
Large LCD screen: high-definition display of torque values, units, and working modes, still clear in low light environments.
Communication port: Supports torque data export (such as connecting to a computer/mobile phone) for quality analysis and traceability.
Buzzer: Automatically sounds when the set torque is reached to avoid human error.
Operation buttons (C/U/V, etc.): Implement functions such as mode switching, unit conversion, data storage/clearing, etc.
Tail and handle:
Battery cover: easy to disassemble and replace, ensuring continuous operation.
Anti slip handle: Ergonomic design, comfortable grip, reduces fatigue from prolonged operation.
4、 Core functional highlights
Precise torque control:
The accuracy reaches ± 1% (within full range), ensuring that every tightening meets the standard and avoiding "over tightening fracture, under tightening loosening".
Multi mode adaptation:
Tracking mode: Real time display of applied torque, dynamic monitoring of tightening process.
Peak mode: Record the maximum torque during tightening for easy review afterwards.
Preset mode: Set the target torque, sound and light dual alarms (beep+screen display) when reaching the standard, and force standardized operation.
Flexible switching of units:
Supports units such as N · m, ft · lb, kgf · cm, covering metric and imperial standards, and adapting to the needs of different industries.
Data management:
Built in storage chip, capable of recording multiple sets of torque data; Combining communication functions to achieve data export and information management, adapting to the quality traceability system of modern production lines.
Durability guarantee:
The main body is made of chrome vanadium steel material, which is impact resistant, corrosion-resistant, and stable and reliable in dealing with complex working conditions such as oil pollution and vibration.
5、 Typical application scenarios
In the automotive field, torque calibration of tire bolts, engine components, and chassis screws meets original factory standards.
Mechanical assembly: Precision assembly of industrial equipment and machine tools to ensure the stability of equipment operation.
Aerospace: critical links such as cabin connection and pipeline fixation require strict torque control for safety.
Home appliance manufacturing: Assembly of core components such as motors and compressors to enhance product lifespan and reliability.
